title_en: Supplementary Provisions (III) of the Supreme People's Court and the Supreme People's Procuratorate on the Implementation of the Criminal Law of the People's Republic of China for the Determination of Charges

articles.content_en:
October 25, 2007
Supreme People's Court Supreme People's Procuratorate
Supplementary Provisions on Determining Criminal Charges for Implementing the Criminal Law of the People's Republic of China (III)
Fa Shi [2007] No. 16
(Adopted at the 1436th Session of the Adjudication Committee of the Supreme People's Court on August 27, 2007, and at the 82nd Session of the Tenth Procuratorial Committee of the Supreme People's Procuratorate on September 7, 2007; Promulgated by the Announcement of the Supreme People's Court and the Supreme People's Procuratorate on October 25, 2007, and shall come into force as of November 6, 2007)
In accordance with the provisions of the Amendment (V) to the Criminal Law of the People's Republic of China (hereinafter referred to as the "Amendment (V) to the Criminal Law") and the Amendment (VI) to the Criminal Law of the People's Republic of China (hereinafter referred to as the "Amendment (VI) to the Criminal Law"), the following supplements and amendments are made to the Provisions of the Supreme People's Court on Determining Criminal Charges for Implementing the Criminal Law of the People's Republic of China, the Opinions of the Supreme People's Procuratorate on the Names of Crimes under the Specific Provisions of the Criminal Law, and the Supplementary Provisions of the Supreme People's Court and the Supreme People's Procuratorate on Determining Criminal Charges for Implementing the Criminal Law of the People's Republic of China:
